check_one_hot_tensor: check if a PyTorch tensor is one-hot encoded along the last dimension
validate_one_hot_encoding: validate that a tensor contains only binary values with exactly one 1 per row
test_is_one_hot_tensor: test the is_one_hot_tensor function with a valid one-hot encoded tensor
verify_binary_tensor: verify a tensor is binary before checking one-hot encoding along a specified dimension
summarize_is_one_hot_tensor: summarize the is_one_hot_tensor function that checks binary tensors for one-hot encoding
